scope: Document cursor direction, pixel refresh, close restoration and original page navigation; development alpha

cause.direction: gMousePointer::setImage skipped pixel upload when a composed cursor bitmap reused the same address, dimensions and hotspot. Left and right cursor images have equal dimensions.
cause.restoration: Closing a document cleared hover references without restoring the cursor; Escape and bookmark callbacks did not reset it.

fix.pixels: Upload current pixels on every cursor image update, including same-address and same-size images
fix.document: Centralized local-coordinate cursor selection for open, move, drag and release; close control and outside areas use the normal pointer
fix.close: Document close and destruction restore the original normal pointer and hotspot
fix.interfaces: Existing virtual open/close overrides only; no new public platform API or CLI options

public_regression.stderr: runtime-test: Cursor pixels must refresh when the bitmap address and size are reused

options_layouts: pre-game variant invoked by integration harness
checks: Exact displayed cursor pixels match original graphics; both native cursor and pointer offsets match the original hotspots
Repeated left/right motion across the book center, including immediately adjacent pixels
Mouse page clicks advance and return; first and last spreads clamp without changing directional cursors
Dragging across the document and releasing refreshes direction
Bookmark and outside hover use the normal pointer
Escape closes from both page-arrow states; bookmark closure is exercised after both states
No motion is injected between closing and checking the restored normal cursor
Options modal focus, actor, coordinates, RNG, party flags and settings remain unchanged
Scroll and parchment preserve up/down arrows, center boundary, dragging, stationary opening and both close paths
document_scenarios.staged_page_break_fix: Preserved the existing null-terminator copy correction and final-credits-paragraph regression; credits-last.ppm is captured
document_scenarios.prior_scenarios: Hot Keys, music mute, empty Load, save/load, Credits content, Speech Text persistence and missing-voice fallback also pass

memory.result: Two-process AddressSanitizer and LeakSanitizer integration passed
memory.environment: Executed outside the sandbox to permit LeakSanitizer thread inspection

windows.build: Zig cross-build, Windows x64 Release, SDL 3.4.18
windows.execution: Native Windows processes from an extracted preflight complete ZIP with bundled-data discovery and an unrelated working directory

capture_method: Separate cursor-inclusive PPM captures composite the validated native cursor pixels and current position over the indexed framebuffer using the active palette. Existing parity captures still omit cursors.

packages.validation: Final archives retain the identical executable and SDL library tested in the preflight package; complete data allowlist remains eight baseline-matching files

limitations: Automated SDL input; no new manual hardware or desktop test
